summary: Implemented `cycle-12-protected-flange-subtype-verification`. Added deterministic flange subtype recognition and evidence checks, exposed subtype labels to reranker prompts only for explicit subtype queries, and added matcher post-rerank validation that keeps the first compatible selected candidate or returns `NOT_FOUND` with a diagnostic reason. Updated the production reranker prompt and marked all 7 OpenSpec tasks complete. Changed files are limited to allowed production matcher/constraint/reranker modules, the reranker prompt asset, and focused tests.
